detail.longDescription:
PocketGem transforms your phone into a powerful, private AI workstation. Run the latest Large Language Models (LLMs) like Qwen 2.5, Gemma, and Gemini Nano locally on your device.

Enjoy a completely offline AI agent with zero data tracking, zero latency, and zero subscription fees. Whether you need a secure coding assistant or a private document analyzer, PocketGem runs entirely on your hardware.

🚀 TOP FEATURES

🔒 100% Offline & Private
• Local Inference: AI models run directly on your CPU, GPU, and NPU.
• No Internet Needed: Chat, analyze docs, and run tools without Wi-Fi.
• Zero Tracking: No telemetry, no cloud servers, no analytics.
• Encrypted Vault: API keys and data are secured via Android Keystore.

📄 Chat with your Documents (RAG)
• Interactive Analysis: Import files and chat with your documents instantly.
• Local RAG: Turn PDFs, DOCX, and TXT files into a searchable Knowledge Base.
• Instant Answers: Ask questions about your files and get citations for every answer.
• Privacy First: Your sensitive documents never leave your device.

🤖 Multi-Model Support (New!)
• Qwen 2.5: Run the latest high-performance models instantly—no account required.
• Gemini Nano: Experience Google's efficient on-device AI.
• Gemma 3 & 3n: Optimized for mobile with INT4/INT8 quantization.
• Hugging Face: Download additional models directly from the hub.

⚡ AI Agent & MCP Tools
• Autonomous Agent: Complex problem solving with "Thought Chains."
• MCP Support: Connect to external data via Model Context Protocol.
• Built-in Tools: Calculator, Weather, and private Brave Search.

⚙️ Power User Controls
• Custom Context: Up to 32K context window for long documents.
• Sampler Settings: Fine-tune Temperature, Top-P, and Top-K.
• Tech Stack: Switch between CPU, GPU, and NNAPI acceleration.

📱 REQUIREMENTS
• RAM: 6GB (Minimum), 8GB+ (Recommended for Qwen/Gemma 3n), 12GB+ (Best Performance).
• Storage: 4–8GB free space for model weights.
• Android: 8.0+

🎯 WHY POCKETGEM?

Most AI apps send your data to the cloud. PocketGem keeps your intelligence local. Perfect for privacy advocates, researchers, and anyone who wants a "brain in their pocket" that works anywhere, anytime.

Download now to run Qwen 2.5 and Gemma offline!
